cues.en: In the previous video, you learned that scaling is a common potential problem with LMS and large deep learning models in general.
cues.zh: 上一支影片學過，縮放是 LLM，以及大型深度學習模型常見的潛在問題。

cues.en: Frequent normalizations is one strategy for dealing with these numerical issues, and in this video
cues.zh: 經常正規化，是處理數值問題的一種策略，這支影片

cues.en: you will learn about another strategy, which is weight initialization.
cues.zh: 要學另一種：權重初始化。

cues.en: Now obviously, all of the weight values start off at random numbers and are tweaked over time through gradient descent.
cues.zh: 顯然，權重值從隨機數開始，隨時間透過梯度下降調整。

cues.en: But it turns out that how you create those random numbers in the beginning actually does have implications for how well they can be tweaked and optimized.
cues.zh: 但最初如何建立隨機數，其實會影響之後調整、最佳化的效果。

cues.en: Now, in theory, this shouldn't really matter.
cues.zh: 理論上，這應該沒什麼差。

cues.en: If the weights are getting too large and out of hand, then you might think that gradient descent would just shrink the weights so that the performance is still good.
cues.zh: 權重太大、不受控制時，你可能以為梯度下降自然會把它縮小，維持良好表現。

cues.en: This actually is the case for relatively small models, but very large models can just become so unstable
cues.zh: 相對小的模型確實可能如此，但大模型會非常不穩定，

cues.en: and there are so many multiplications that any help you can give the model to optimize its training is going to be beneficial.
cues.zh: 乘法又太多，因此能幫助最佳化訓練的方法，都有好處。

cues.en: So that's the idea of weight initialization.
cues.zh: 這就是權重初始化的概念。

cues.en: It's actually pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 相當直接。

cues.en: You want the weights to be random but have fairly small values.
cues.zh: 希望權重隨機，但數值相當小。

cues.en: So in the slides here I will introduce you to three methods for initializing the weights.
cues.zh: 投影片會介紹三種方法。

cues.en: Although in practice it doesn't really matter which method you use, as long as the overall numerical range of the weights is fairly small.
cues.zh: 實務上用哪種沒那麼重要，只要整體權重數值範圍相當小。

cues.en: So here's a couple of more discussion points about weight initializations.
cues.zh: 再談幾點。

cues.en: If the weights are too small, then you risk the model just not learning anything, which is also called vanishing gradients.
cues.zh: 權重太小，可能讓模型完全學不到東西，也叫梯度消失。

cues.en: At the extreme, imagine what would happen if all the weights were equal to zero.
cues.zh: 想像極端情況，所有權重全是零。

cues.en: The model would just calculate and then output zeros for any possible input.
cues.zh: 模型就只計算、對任何輸入都輸出零。

cues.en: On the other hand, if the weights are too big, then you start running into numerical issues and you
cues.zh: 另一方面，權重太大，開始出現數值問題，

cues.en: saw a bit of that in the previous video as, uh, about numerical scaling issues with softmax.
cues.zh: 上一支談 softmax 數值縮放時，已看過一些。

cues.en: So there are basically two solutions for this problem.
cues.zh: 基本上有兩種解法。

cues.en: And these are complementary solutions, by the way.
cues.zh: 而且兩者互補。

cues.en: It's not like you pick one or the other.
cues.zh: 不是只能二選一。

cues.en: So you want to initialize the weights to be small numbers but not too small.
cues.zh: 把權重初始化為小數字，但別太小。

cues.en: And there are methods to make scaling of the weights proportional to the size of the network.
cues.zh: 也有方法，讓權重縮放與網路大小相關。

cues.en: Now this you've already seen several times before, with scaling by the square root of the embeddings dimensionality in the attention equation.
cues.zh: 這你已看過好幾次，例如注意力方程式以嵌入維度平方根縮放。

cues.en: And also we did this sometimes at the end of the model in when outputting the logits.
cues.zh: 有時也在模型結尾、輸出 logit 時做。

cues.en: Uh, by the way, it is fairly common to initialize the weights matrices and ignore the bias terms in the initialization.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，常見做法是初始化權重矩陣，忽略偏置項。

cues.en: Some people do also initialize the bias terms, but the thing is that there are so few bias terms compared
cues.zh: 有人也初始化偏置，但因為偏置數量遠少於

cues.en: to the weights that just practically speaking, it really doesn't matter what you do with the bias terms.
cues.zh: 權重，實務上怎麼處理偏置，沒那麼重要。

cues.en: Uh, and yeah, the motivation for initializing the weights is that it's just one more strategy, along
cues.zh: 初始化的動機，是再多一個策略，配合

cues.en: with layernorm and explicit division by dimensionality, in hopes of stabilizing all of the numerical values within the model.
cues.zh: LayerNorm、明確除以維度等方式，希望穩定模型內所有數值。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I'm going to tell you about two common weight initializations.
cues.zh: 現在介紹兩種常見初始化。

cues.en: There's a third initialization that we are going to explore in the code.
cues.zh: 程式碼還會探索第三種。

cues.zh: 但那只是小變異數的常態分布。

cues.en: So I don't have a slide about that.
cues.zh: 所以沒另外做投影片。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So one common initialization is called chiming.
cues.zh: 一種常見初始化叫 Kaiming。

cues.en: This is named after the author of the paper that introduced this approach.
cues.zh: 以提出這個方法的論文作者命名。

cues.en: It's very simple.
cues.zh: 很簡單。

cues.en: The weights are initialized to be a uniform distribution, with bounds of the distribution determined by the number of input neurons into this weights matrix.
cues.zh: 權重初始化為均勻分布，上下界由這個權重矩陣的輸入神經元數量決定。

cues.en: Intuitively, you can see that as the weights matrix gets larger and larger, sigma gets smaller and smaller, which means the distribution of the weights gets closer to zero.
cues.zh: 直覺上，矩陣越大，sigma 越小，權重分布就越靠近零。

cues.en: This is actually the default for non-linear in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 這其實是 PyTorch nn.Linear 的預設做法。

cues.en: Another common procedure is called Xavier, also named after the author of the paper.
cues.zh: 另一個常用方法叫 Xavier，同樣以論文作者命名。

cues.en: So here we have.
cues.zh: 這裡有，

cues.en: The weights are distributed as a normal distribution, where the variance of that distribution is also a function of the total size of the weights matrix.
cues.zh: 權重呈常態分布，變異數也是整個權重矩陣大小的函數。

cues.en: So the formula is slightly different compared to the one for Chi Ming, but the implication is the same.
cues.zh: 公式與 Kaiming 稍有不同，但含義相同。

cues.en: So as the weights matrix gets larger, the variance gets smaller.
cues.zh: 矩陣越大，變異數越小。

cues.en: As I mentioned, the third method that I'll show you in the code for initializing weights is basically
cues.zh: 第三種初始化，程式碼會展示，基本上

cues.en: the same as Xavier, but we're going to pick an arbitrary number here instead of defining it based on the matrix size.
cues.zh: 和 Xavier 相同，但這裡隨意選一個數字，不依矩陣大小定義。

cues.zh: 但其實是權重值的直方圖。

cues.zh: 先告訴你，這裡藍色分布的變異數，
